lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hello Marie, it's Yolanda. Do you have a few minutes for our call?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hi, sorry, I'm in the car but I can talk.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Here's what I had in mind for today, but tell me if you'd rather focus on something else.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How's your energy been this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not great. I haven't been sleeping.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's hard to think about goals when your body isn't cooperating.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why is this important to you right now?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: My granddaughter is why I'm doing this.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What do you think the next step should be?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I have to do something, I don't want the cancer back. It's just me and my husband now, so it's easier.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Could you do them while you watch TV?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not yet. I kept saying tomorrow, tomorrow.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Part of you wants this, and part of you is just worn out.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're weighing it up, and that's fair.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I need this for my head too, not just my body.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Whatever you pick is fine with me. It's your plan.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sometimes. I just forgot.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It slipped your mind.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Walking hurts my knees, so why bother.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would your family say about these changes?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I feel better about myself when I stick to it. My daughter keeps reminding me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're really honest with yourself, and that helps.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I already told my family about my goal.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would make it easier next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: If I plan it the night before, I can do it. I didn't think I'd like it, but I do.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Once you decide something, you follow through.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm going to do it Monday, Wednesday and Friday. My doctor said the same thing.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Would it be okay if I shared something that's helped other people?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A lot of people do the band exercises while they watch TV. It makes it feel like less of a chore.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm just so tired, I don't have it in me. I feel guilty when I skip it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you mind if I tell you what some people do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A lot of people do the band exercises while they watch TV. It makes it feel like less of a chore.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I kept saying tomorrow, tomorrow. I don't want to end up like my dad.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you still have the band we gave you?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why is this important to you right now?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Well, I put a reminder on the fridge. At least I'm trying.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're starting to see that small changes add up.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I put a reminder on the fridge.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Part of you is already moving, and you want to keep that going.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You'd rather start small and actually stick with it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll set an alarm on my phone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You want to be around and be well for the people you love.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I need to get my sugar down.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How would things be different if you kept this up?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I put a reminder on the fridge.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What feels doable for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll try to do the band exercises 4 times.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Like a 10.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If getting started gets in the way again, what's your backup plan?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll keep some fruit cut up in the fridge.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay, so your plan this week is to do the band exercises 4 times. Did I get that right?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, and I'll really try this time.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Monday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Perfect.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Take care, Marie. You're doing great.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thank you, Yolanda. Bye!

tags.note: Leading suggestion framed as question; pushes a specific strategy.
Pressure toward follow-through; undermines the autonomy stated in line 30.
Verbatim repeat of line 35; does not address fatigue or guilt.
Repeats earlier 'why is this important' question.

flags.reason: 'Once you decide something, you follow through' pressures commitment right after offering autonomy.
Verbatim repeat of line 35 ignores participant's fatigue and guilt (line 36).
Participant voiced fear of 'ending up like my dad'; coach did not reflect or explore it.
Leading closed question pushed a specific strategy before the participant's own ideas were explored.

score.summary: Coach used good open questions and reflections early, then repeated a scripted suggestion and pushed follow-through, which undercut the autonomy offered. The participant still set a concrete goal (band exercises 4 times) with a barrier plan and confidence rating, and the coach closed with a clear summary and next contact.
strengths: Line 33 and 37 asked permission before offering suggestions.
Line 45 and 47 reflected Marie's growing momentum and ambivalence well.
Line 61 planned for barriers with an open backup-plan question.
Line 63 and 65 summarized the goal and set the next contact.
coaching_tips: Line 39 repeated line 35 word for word; respond to the fatigue and guilt Marie named in line 36 instead.
Line 31 pressures follow-through right after line 30 offered choice; drop the pressure and reflect her commitment.
Reflect the 'not ending up like my dad' fear (line 40) before moving on; it is strong change talk.
Line 43 repeated the 'why is this important' question; use the answer from line 10 as a reflection instead.
Review the previous goal at the start of the call, which was skipped here.
